note: This registry is the ONLY place a source tier is assigned. Documents inherit their tier from their source_id; validate_corpus.py fails any document whose source_tier disagrees with the registry. This mirrors the design's requirement that tier is a property of the source, never of the content, and is never modified by detector output.

cisa_ics_medical.license_note: US Government work, public domain. Bodies in this corpus are synthesized, not reproduced.
